title: Alcmena
summary: Raleigh names Alcmena in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Alcmena, mother of that Hercules to whom the Greekes ascribe the twelue labours. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. VI, sig. 291a
